name: Nimiq
rootCause: GSN forwarder skips signature check, relying solely on attacker-chosen paymaster. Lost: ~$50,463.79 (USDC, USDT0, USDC.e drained from a swap-liquidity wallet's standing approvals)

descriptions.text: GSN forwarder skips signature check, relying solely on attacker-chosen paymaster. Lost: ~$50,463.79 (USDC, USDT0, USDC.e drained from a swap-liquidity wallet's standing approvals)

An attacker abused an OpenGSN meta-transaction auth flaw on Polygon HTLC contracts: open/execute accepted a spoofed from without a real user signature. Posing as liquidity wallet 0x24cb…6773, they used leftover near-unlimited ERC-20 allowances to lock 26,130.64171 USDC, 24,332.489269 USDT0 and 0.661117 USDC.e into HTLCs with attacker-chosen recipient and secretHash=sha256(1), then redeemed via a CREATE2 contract with secret=1. Single-tx loss was about $50,463.
